tldr: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5 and the higher Mythos 5 tier on Jun 9. Early independent hands-on framed it as a powerful but slow and expensive “beast” that is “relentlessly proactive,” while Latent Space flagged controversial usage terms shipped alongside it. Anthropic published access details on Jun 12 — then on Jun 13 the story turned sharply: the US government issued an export-control directive to suspend access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5.
whats_new: The latest beat is a hard external shock: a US government export-control directive ordering access to Fable 5 / Mythos 5 suspended — a regulatory escalation well beyond the earlier product and usage-policy debate.
why_it_matters: For anyone building on frontier models, this thread is a live lesson in supply risk: a model can go from “ship it” to “access suspended by directive” in four days. Keep a fallback model wired in rather than hard-coding a single top tier into production.
